title: ListThreadsParams
description:
Optional params for the `thread/list` RPC.

Omitting params (or sending `null`) lists every thread. Sending `{ "cwd": "/path" }` restricts the result to threads created under that directory.

# Examples

``` use zhive_proto::rpc::ListThreadsParams; let p: ListThreadsParams = serde_json::from_str("{}").unwrap(); assert!(p.cwd.is_none()); let p: ListThreadsParams = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"cwd":"/work"}"#).unwrap(); assert_eq!(p.cwd.as_deref(), Some("/work")); ```

cwd.description: Optional working-directory filter; `None` lists all threads.
